item.title: Paper: Topological Attribution Distance (TAD): Revealing Segment-Level RAG Influence on LLM Output Geometry for Incident Log Analysis
item.description: This paper introduces a method to trace LLM outputs back to specific RAG segments, helping cybersecurity analysts verify the evidence behind automated decisions.

item.title: Paper: HAF: Adapting Generalist VLAs to Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-manipulation via Hierarchical Action Flow and Spectral Latent RL
item.description: The authors propose a hierarchical framework to help generalist vision-language models coordinate complex, full-body movements for humanoid robots more effectively.

item.title: Paper: TDD-Agent: Test-Driven Reasoning for Code Generation
item.description: TDD-Agent improves code generation by forcing models to write and pass tests before implementation, ensuring higher accuracy for complex programming tasks.

item.title: Paper: Quipu: A Governed Bitemporal Knowledge Graph Store
item.description: Quipu is a specialized knowledge graph store designed for AI agents that enforces strict governance and bitemporal tracking to ensure data reliability.

item.title: Paper: Handover of In-Context Learning State Across Session Boundaries
item.description: This paper explores how to efficiently transfer context between LLM sessions, helping developers maintain task continuity when hitting input limits or restarting applications.

item.title: Paper: Universal Thermodynamic Interatomic Potentials for Crystalline Materials
item.description: The authors introduce a method to calculate Gibbs free energy for materials using automatic differentiation, enabling faster and more accurate computational discovery of stable crystalline structures.

item.title: Paper: Rollplex: Cross-Phase GPU Spatial Sharing for Vision Language Model Post-Training
item.description: This research optimizes VLM training by overlapping video processing and model execution, significantly reducing GPU idle time during reinforcement learning post-training.

item.title: Paper: SheetCompass: Hierarchical Relation Graphs for Agentic Spreadsheet Reasoning
item.description: The authors propose a hierarchical graph approach for spreadsheets that preserves spatial and relational data, allowing LLMs to reason about complex workbooks more effectively than flat text.

item.title: Paper: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
item.description: This model series integrates multimodal scientific data and tool-use capabilities to help researchers automate complex, long-term reasoning tasks in scientific discovery.

item.title: Paper: AaLLM: An End-to-End Analog Circuit Design Framework from Topology Generation to Sizing Using Large Language Models
item.description: This framework automates the entire analog circuit design process, from topology to sizing, using LLMs to reduce the manual effort and expertise typically required for circuit optimization.

item.title: Paper: RAIL: An Automatic Classifier of the Artificial Intelligence Readiness Level
item.description: The authors propose a unified framework to automatically assess the maturity of AI projects, helping data scientists and stakeholders standardize how they evaluate technology readiness.

item.title: Paper: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
item.description: AutoDesign introduces a meta-harness system that allows AI agents to recursively improve their own design workflows, enabling more efficient and autonomous long-horizon creative tasks.

item.title: Paper: SAG: SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation with Query-Time Dynamic Hyperedges
item.description: This method uses SQL-based retrieval to handle structured data queries more effectively than traditional vector search, offering a more flexible way to ground LLMs in complex datasets.

item.title: Paper: Beyond Trial-and-Error: Agentic Optimization for Image-to-Video Adherence
item.description: This framework replaces manual trial-and-error in video generation with an agentic feedback loop, helping data scientists automate and stabilize the output of image-to-video models.

item.title: Paper: A Cascaded Unsupervised-Supervised NLP Pipeline for Detecting Accusatory Language in Public Procurement
item.description: The authors present a hybrid NLP pipeline to identify potentially corrupt language in public procurement documents, demonstrating how to monitor large-scale government data for irregularities.

item.title: Paper: Diagram-MMU: A Multi-Modal Benchmark for Scientific Diagrams
item.description: This benchmark provides a standardized way to evaluate how well multimodal models interpret complex scientific diagrams, which is critical for automating technical document analysis.

item.title: Paper: Mapping and Measuring the Behavioral Evolution of Large Language Models
item.description: The authors developed a method to quantify and track how LLM behaviors diverge or converge over time, helping practitioners understand model evolution beyond simple leaderboard scores.

item.title: Paper: Self-Knowledge Retrieval Augmented Generation Framework for Patent Matching
item.description: This framework improves patent matching accuracy by using a self-knowledge RAG approach, avoiding the high costs and performance degradation associated with traditional fine-tuning.

item.title: Paper: Test-Time Self-Evolving GUI Visual Grounding via Reflection-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
item.description: This method allows GUI agents to improve their visual grounding capabilities post-deployment through an automated reflection loop, enabling adaptation to new interfaces without human feedback.

item.title: Paper: Hierarchical Empirical-Bayes Naive Bayes: Minimax Smoothing and Calibration with AODE Extension
item.description: The researchers introduced an adaptive smoothing method for Naive Bayes that automatically adjusts to data characteristics, significantly improving classification performance on complex tabular datasets.
